messages:
jamie: Quick heads-up — planning a split unpin of runtime v2.15 for llamaX-quant in eu-canary tonight during the low-traffic window (02:00-03:00 UTC). Goal: validate kernel compatibility w/ quant path.
neha: What failure modes are we concerned about? OOMs, KV cache corruption, or inference hangs?
jamie: Main risks: kernel mismatch causing slowdowns, and a small chance of late OOMs on long-seq. KV cache drift unlikely but covered by canary traffic split.
sre-liz: I can be oncall for the window. Recommend circuit-breaker at 5% error spike and immediate re-pin to v2.14 if latency >150ms p95 for 5min.
matt: Can we pre-warm a pinned pool to speed rollback?
jamie: Yes — matt will keep a 2-node pinned pool warm in eu-west-1. Rollback steps: 1) flip deploy-bot pin back to 2.14, 2) drain new runtime pods, 3) route traffic.
product-qa: We'll run the small regression prompt set after unpin: smoke + 20 long-seq prompts. Expect ~10min per run.
jamie: deploy-bot, schedule the unpin at 02:10 UTC, split traffic 10%->50%->100% over 30m, attach telemetry checks: p95 latency, error rate, and token-output-diff. If any check fails, abort and re-pin.
deploy-bot: @jamie scheduled job created: id=job-3301-eu-unpin. Actions: unpin runtime=2.15, target=models=[llamaX-quant], rollout=[10,50,100], window=2026-03-23T02:10:00Z. Notify: @sre-liz @matt.
neha: Can you paste the exact abort command for ops?
sre-liz: Abort/rollback command:```/deploy revert --job-id job-3301-eu-unpin --target runtime=2.14 --force```
jamie: Also adding a soft safeguard: if token-output-diff > 1.5% on the eval suite, we'll automatically revoke unpin. product-qa, we'll run eval at 02:20 after 10% ramp.
product-qa: Acknowledged. We'll post results in this thread.
matt: Prewarming done — pinned pool at 2 nodes. I'll monitor DRAM/VM allocation and post when green.
deploy-bot: job-3301-eu-unpin status: scheduled -> prewarm-check queued.
jamie: Thanks — final checklist: @sre-liz oncall, @matt prewarm verified, QA eval ready, deploy-bot job created. If anyone objects speak now or we proceed. :eyes:
neha: LGTM, no objections from infra.
sre-liz: Oncall confirmed. I'll run the rollback if triggers fire. :thumbsup:
product-qa: Posting preliminary eval plan and test list below, will update with timestamps once run.
jamie: Moving to execution mode. I'll post post-mortem notes and any oddities here.
deploy-bot: job-3301-eu-unpin status: prewarm-check passed. ready to start at 2026-03-23T02:10:00Z.
